sign.operation: Frontal wide of Odysseus carrying the sulphur fire through the hall, the women entering in a line, each embracing him.

scenes.world: a dim stone banquet hall with timber roof beams, lit only by hearth fire and oil lamps, silent-era costume drama look; morning after, thick sulphur smoke, flat white light through the haze.

captain.asks: Frontal wide: Odysseus carries the sulphur fire through the hall; the women enter in a line, each embracing him; the old nurse goes up the stair.
diagnosis: Hand-tinted colour stairs and a fairy-tale bedroom flood every row; refusing them is the whole job.
Smoke carries: the brazier interior and the cauldron are the cut's strongest bodies.
The embraces never happen; the line of women is seen from behind in modern coats.

prologue: The doors are locked, the weapons are gone, and the beggar holds the bow. Now Odysseus reveals himself and takes back his house by force.
